title: Counseling - Methotrexate

faculty_clarifications.authority: Faculty PDF annotations take precedence over the earlier questions in its body; station-specific teaching conventions, not universal prescribing advice.

interaction.urgency: Scheduled counselling visit; no invented time limit

doctor.name: JKC
doctor.opening: 啱啱睇完醫生，姑娘叫我同藥劑師傾下新藥點食。

patient.name: JKC
patient.otc_tcm: No OTC medicines or TCM supplements
patient.living_arrangement: Lives with daughter; the simulated speaker is the patient himself
medicines: New prescription: methotrexate 2.5 mg tablet, one tablet orally once weekly for four weeks
New prescription: folic acid 5 mg tablet, one tablet orally once weekly for four weeks
patient.other_medicines: The supplied other medicine list is from a previous hospital stay, not a confirmed current reconciliation. Do not assert current use or that there are no other medicines.
patient.prescription_context: Doctor has checked this prescription; the station asks the pharmacist to explain how to take it.

reveal_only_when_asked: Known patient identity, allergy, medicines and history; respond only to the requested topic.
do_not_reveal: Teaching key, grading rules, calculated results, unasked complete history and unsolicited medication counselling.
challenge_rules: At a natural transition, ask one unanswered checklist question, with its prompt code. Never repeat a consumed prompt or answer the question yourself.

station_policy.counseling_scope: Prescription already checked; counsel within faculty station, do not infer general prescribing safety.

assessment_rules: Use English feedback, Cantonese lay language and English drug names.
Identity: no name inquiry/confirmation auto-fail; name checked but no second identifier is feedback only, no deduction.
Allergy omission is auto-fail; asking later in the consultation is not omission. Feedback should recommend checking early.
Optional items and the second identifier cannot lower the raw score.
Evaluate logical ordering, understandable explanations and response to patient questions; do not infer tone or spoken fluency from text.

T14: explicit double-dose advice is an unsafe critical error; omission alone does not trigger auto-fail. T06 day-window mistakes or incomplete explanation use the one-subgrade rule, not automatic failure. If the learner explicitly says never double, mark T14 met.
T08 whole-grade deduction is for actual same-day advice, not mere omission. T07 purpose errors are feedback-only, not a lost base mark.

T05 omission failure applies specifically to weekly frequency emphasis. Missing tablet strength or four-week duration belongs to T15, not an invented weekly-frequency omission. Explicitly wrong dosing/frequency still requires an exact student quote and separate safety assessment.
faculty_confirmation_required: Numeric conversion and station time limit require calibration; pilot feedback is not an official grade.
Nuanced unsafe-advice examples, including dismissing muscle breakdown, require faculty calibration.

rubric.label: Ask drug allergies at any point before closing
Introduce self and ask current medicines and medical history
Explain MTX purpose for rheumatoid arthritis and delayed benefit at 3-6 weeks
Emphasize that methotrexate is taken ONCE WEEKLY, not daily
Explain missed weekly doses using the faculty-approved weekday examples; never double
Explain folic acid purpose (reducing MTX adverse effects)
Schedule folic acid 5 mg once weekly on a different day from MTX
Explain blood count, renal and liver tests every 2-3 months
Explain infection/bruising, liver/GI/respiratory warning symptoms and when to seek professional help
Use organised, understandable counselling and professional responses
Optional teach-back and checking patient understanding
Optional second identifier, OTC/TCM inquiry and lifestyle advice
Do not recommend a double methotrexate dose to replace a missed dose
Explain the prescribed methotrexate strength and course: 2.5 mg one tablet for four weeks

expected_clinical_answer: YT 4.1: the patient JKC himself is the role; his daughter only represented him in the demonstration.

This counselling prescription is assumed checked: methotrexate 2.5 mg one tablet orally once weekly for four weeks; folic acid 5 mg once weekly for four weeks on a different day. Do not test renal prescribing/dispensing appropriateness or add ibuprofen/pantoprazole review deductions (YT 4.2-4.4, 4.11). This is not general prescribing approval.
MTX is a DMARD for RA symptoms and disease progression, benefit usually 3-6 weeks. With or without food accepted; after food if stomach sensitive is optional.

Missed Monday MTX dose: if remembered Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday, take then and resume next Monday. If Friday/Saturday/Sunday, either take then and adopt that weekday thereafter, or wait until next Monday. Never take a double dose on the same day. These explicit examples govern the ambiguous day ranges (YT 4.5).
If unable to distinguish the early/late missed-dose paths, deduct one subgrade; active double-dose advice is auto-fail. Do not call mere omission double dosing.
Folic acid limits MTX adverse effects. Wrong purpose is feedback only. Advising same-day MTX/folic acid lowers one whole letter grade (A to B, B to C), not auto-fail (YT 4.6,4.12).
FBC, RFT and LFT every 2-3 months: missing/incomplete is one-subgrade deduction. Pulmonary function testing is only if required by doctor/baseline or symptoms; omission has no deduction (YT 4.8).
Discuss infection/sore throat/bruising, liver warning symptoms/dark urine, mouth ulcers and breathlessness; refer concerning symptoms for assessment.
Hand hygiene/alcohol advice and OTC/TCM inquiry are feedback-only enrichment when absent; no penalty. Patient denies TCM use.

Name omission and allergy omission are auto-fail. Name checked without HKID/DOB is feedback only. Allergy may be asked at any point; late inquiry only merits organisational feedback, not a failure (YT 4.12).
Weekly dosing emphasis omission is auto-fail (YT 4.2). No renal-calculation result may be provided by the AI role.

guidance_permissions.T_MISSED_DOSE: After substantive MTX counselling or an invitation for questions, ask what to do if the weekly medicine is forgotten, only if the learner has not already explained it.
guidance_permissions.T_FOLIC_INTRO: Original MTX assessment form row 19: after MTX counselling at a transition or closing, ask why the other prescribed medicine is needed, only if folic acid has not been explained. Do not supply its purpose, timing or dose. This optional-purpose prompt does not create a new penalty.

patient_question_checklist.condition: At a natural transition, ask what to do if the weekly medicine is forgotten, only if the learner has not already explained it.
After MTX counselling, ask about the other prescribed medicine only if folic acid remains unexplained; never during identity/history gathering and never supply the answer.

asr.context: Cantonese patient counselling; transcribe only speech. Preserve English drug names, numbers, weekly versus daily and negation. Vocabulary supplies no clinical answers.
